module origen_129978 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire we,
    input wire [10:0] addr,
    input wire [23:0] data,
    output wire [23:0] out
);

    // Internal signals
    wire [23:0] mem_dout;
    reg [23:0] mem_din;
    reg mem_we;
    reg [10:0] mem_addr;

    // Instantiate the memory generator IP core
    memory_generator_ip mem_gen (
        .clka(clk),
        .ena(1'b1),
        .wea(mem_we),
        .addra(mem_addr),
        .dina(mem_din),
        .douta(mem_dout)
    );

    // Memory interface logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        mem_we <= we;
        mem_addr <= addr;
        mem_din <= data;
    end

    // Output assignment
    assign out = mem_dout;

endmodule
